summary: This directory provides utilities for text encoding and decoding within stream pipelines. It serves as a bridge for processing character-based data by converting binary chunks into readable strings and vice versa, ensuring compatibility across stream processing workflows.
responsibilities: Transform binary data streams into character streams
Convert character strings into binary data streams
Apply text encoding rules during stream processing
relationships: Text encoding facilitates the conversion between binary buffers and readable character streams.
Stream transformations act as intermediaries to process data flows between encoding and decoding stages.
designDecisions: Support for standardized text encoding formats
